purpose: Synthetic residual intervention tests whether replacing eligible future MTP Rin inputs with recorded target residuals changes real proposal survival and instrumented throughput. It does not replace draft IDs or logits.
interpretation: The long BAB tables report whether this synthetic Rin intervention helped or hurt the two fixed cases. Conditional proposal survival and local raw-target agreement remain separate from forced acceptance and from any free-generation claim.

historical_token_oracle.rationale: Historical full-token oracle replaces proposals after real MTP readiness. Rin oracle replaces hidden residual inputs only on eligible fresh steps and preserves proposal token/logit production. Different binaries, allocation/hook and policy-trace instrumentation, separate cache histories and runs prevent a direct ceiling-recovery percentage or normalized speedup comparison.
historical_token_oracle.no_claim: Context for mechanism only; historical full-token timings are not pooled with this run or used to calculate remaining attainable gain.

excluded_from_performance.record_reason: Target residual D2H capture changes timing; record requests only construct immutable banks.
excluded_from_performance.smoke_reason: Short correctness gate, not mixed with long BAB.

limits: Synthetic Rin intervention with genuine MTP proposals on a fixed target continuation; no deployable speedup/free-quality claim.
Record GEN instrumented by D2H capture and excluded from BAB. Every replay loads complete1024 table before decode, including smoke15.

Policy trace and fixed GPU hook/allocation common to all arms. Bank read/hash/upload occurs after prompt_ms and before decode timer: included in wall GEN, excluded from both reported timers; bank_load_ms separate, no subtraction.
Conditional reference prefix stops at first mismatch/budget. Local raw-target agreement does not imply global greedy trajectory equality.
Features recorded with different target window shapes may differ numerically even at matching fixture positions.
Target expert cache elasticity reported without normalization; repeated B arms are not independent samples.
First draft proposal is computed before any Rin injection; a first-proposal mismatch prevents all later injection in that fresh chain.
GPU hook coverage uses the complete1024 bank for all launched chain steps, including beyond a request tail. Proposal quality statistics remain censored by output budget and the first mismatch.
Changing target verifier window shapes can change floating-point residuals; matched position/token history does not imply a bit-exact original target state.
Record banks, extra GPU gate/allocation and policy clocks are laboratory instrumentation. All arms share those resources, but performance is not an uninstrumented production result.
No free-generation equivalence, model-quality improvement, causal fraction of the full-token oracle ceiling, or deployable speedup is claimed.
Resize, PCIe/PLE and timer observations are not subtracted or added to normalize throughput.
